intro: Review what you've learned about refactoring.

options.text: Improving performance even when the outputs change slightly
Rewriting the entire codebase to meet new architectural requirements
Changing internal structure without changing external, observable behavior
Changing the system's behavior to add features faster

questions.prompt: Which scenario is an example of refactoring?

options.text: Change the logic so the same input returns a different output.
Replace a loop with clearer functional code while preserving the same input and output.
Add an endpoint that introduces new externally visible behavior.
Update UI text after marketing requests new wording.
